title: The windows of several current rows are put together without repeating a row
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "n", COUNTROWS ( WINDOW ( -1, REL, 0, REL, ALL ( 'Product'[Product] ), ORDERBY ( 'Product'[Product], ASC ) ) ) )

source.supports: the article's pseudo-DAX of apply semantics takes the DISTINCT of the rows of all the windows, over all the columns of the source table

derivation: Every product is a current row (no row context, no filter). The windows are {Bike}, {Bike, Helmet}, {Helmet, Lock}, {Lock, Scooter}: four distinct rows.
